description: Miesiac, the Moon of Slavic beliefs as a strong young man, the shepherd of the stars, broad shoulders, short silver hair and no beard, a calm cold face with glowing silver eyes, pale skin glowing softly like moonlight, a short belted silver-white tunic, dark blue trousers and tall boots, a bright silver crescent moon floating above his head like a crown with its two tips pointing up, a big round glowing full moon held on his arm like a shield, his other hand raised with cold silver light, standing firmly with feet apart, one bright wide shape filling the whole picture, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, majestic and menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the figure alone, no clouds, no ground, no background, the whole figure inside the picture, the crescent and the moon shield too
